mapper.select: SELECT storeNum FROM usermember WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT recordId FROM parking_records WHERE carNum = #{carNum} AND exitTime IS NULL ORDER BY entryTime DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_discounts (recordId, storeNum, freeMin, id, createdAt) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{storeNum}, #{freeMin}, #{id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT sd.discountId, sd.recordId, sd.storeNum, sd.freeMin, sd.id, sd.createdAt, pr.carNum, pr.entryTime FROM store_discounts sd JOIN parking_records pr ON sd.recordId = pr.recordId WHERE sd.storeNum = #{storeNum} ORDER BY sd.createdAt DESC
